subject_description: a hulking berserker knight in black spiked plate armor with a horned helm, a torn red cape and a gigantic jagged black greatsword
initial_pose: standing side-on facing right, the gigantic greatsword resting on his right shoulder, blade pointing back
description: three powerful spinning slashes in a row: he takes the gigantic greatsword off his shoulder in both hands and holds it straight out to his side at waist height with BOTH ARMS FULLY STRETCHED, then spins round on the spot THREE full turns, one heavy slash per turn, the long blade sweeping flat and reaching FAR out to the left and to the right edges of the picture at full reach every turn, his torn red cape flaring out with the spin; after the third turn he stops facing right, plants his feet and rests the sword on his shoulder again. Feet stay on the same ground line in the middle of the picture. No effects, no swoosh, no smoke, no dust, no motion trails.
